summary: 33 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: enhance session creation with extended metadata (e71b10a)
  • orleans: enhance hero game grains with state persistence (dbf6bd5)
  • models: add target project reference DTO for cross-project proposals (7331d2f)
  • images: add automatic lossless compression with tool detection (74e5668)
  • project: add design document management and site index proxy (c2f52e4)
  • monospecs: add repository configuration and path resolution (937aeca)
  • signalr: add HagiPower status broadcasting and message aggregation (a8de8ab)
  • hagipower: add debug controller and error codes (81aa154)
  • hagipower: add adventure content plugin system (5e9bbae)
  • doubao: add session context and hotword resolution services (dc17798)
  • signalr: add HagiPower status broadcasting to message hub (5cff91b)
  • hero: add Hagipower source type to hero progression system (5455a97)
  • hagipower: add game driver system with realtime probe and XP conversion (6f48742)

HagiCode-org/web

  • sessions: add target projects support to session creation (412c80d)
  • kanban: add repository collapse utilities and component updates (0dceb24)
  • proposal: add project reference selector and optimization failure guide (37e728a)
  • project: add design markdown document management with site import (57e84e8)
  • hero: add hero game mode with adventure runtime and realtime updates (cb00d49)
  • types: update hero types for adventure payload support (b398163)
  • services: update git API and document resolver with theme support (f3556f0)
  • i18n: add proposal locale updates for repository selectors (991ddfb)
  • proposal: update repository selectors with aggregation and UI improvements (fa50868)
  • hero: update components and hooks for adventure and theme support (05715c4)
  • i18n: add translations for hagipower adventure and debug panel (38fdc84)
  • hagipower: add adventure source support to status bar and popover (c2e0a8e)
  • debug: add hagipower debug panel and state management (7a54231)
  • signalr: add adventure run update events and subscriptions (5f492a4)
  • kanban: update dashboard for adventure game scene integration (60090bf)
  • kanban: add adventure game scene hook and localization (93308d0)
  • api: add hero game scene DTOs and API integration (0736bbe)
  • hagipower: add adventure runtime system with content catalog and i18n (9d77a65)
  • vault: add git-backed vault with repository name extraction (cac2f3a)
  • hagipower: add online Hagipower game feature (64d3c48)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui: add project context to voice recording and fix dependencies (88b756e)
  • notifications: add content normalization for empty titles/messages (dc6af9f)
